name: Taktile
what: AI decision platform for credit, risk and fraud decisions at banks, fintechs and insurers (YC S20).

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio; Visionaries Club named as an existing investor in the Feb 2025 Series B.
membership.quote: included existing investors Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Prosus Ventures, Visionaries Club

funding_rounds.note: Vendor data via WebSearch summary: ~$4.7-5M seed in 2021; no primary page found. Total raised $79M after the Series B implies ~$5M before the Series A.
Only the co-leads are named; no Visionaries.
Visionaries Club listed among existing investors.
Named: Balderton, Index, Tiger, YC, Dig Ventures; Visionaries not named. Total $184M.

valuation.quote: No valuation disclosed for the Series B or C (citybiz Series C: not disclosed).

notes: Entry: Visionaries was already an investor by Feb 2025 but no source ties it to the 2021 seed or the 2022 Series A (googlenews for 2020-2022 returned nothing; archived taktile.com 2021/2022 lists no investors; Taktile GmbH's Berlin register shows no capital changes, the cap table sits in a US parent). Most likely the 2021 seed, but unproven. HQ DISPUTE: Balderton, YC and Tiger rows say Berlin; tech.eu (2022-11-22) calls it 'Berlin-founded, now New York-headquartered Taktile', and 2026 Series C coverage files it among NYC rounds (AlleyWatch, Business Journals); offices in both cities.
